$comment: Individual income tax parameters. Draft values pending reconciliation against the research pass — see confidence flags.

legalBasis: NIRC Sec 24(A)(2)(a), as amended by RA 10963 (TRAIN) — rates effective Jan 1, 2023 onward
graduatedBrackets.notes: Base is the tax on the bracket floor; rate applies to the excess over the floor. Watch: pending 2026 bills (House package: ₱350k zero bracket; SB 1685: ₱500k) would change this table from TY2027 if enacted — re-verify before the 2027 tax year.

legalBasis: NIRC Sec 24(A)(2)(b), as amended by RA 10963
eightPercent.notes: In lieu of both graduated income tax and the Sec 116 percentage tax. Unavailable to VAT-registered taxpayers, those over the ₱3M threshold, those subject to other percentage taxes (Secs 117-127), and GPP partners. Mixed-income earners get no extra ₱250,000 reduction on the business side — it is embedded in the graduated computation of their compensation income. Elected each year on or before the first quarterly filing (1701Q, or 2551Q if earlier) or via Form 1905; irrevocable for the year. Breaching ₱3M mid-year puts the ENTIRE year back on graduated rates (8% payments become credits) plus percentage tax until VAT registration.

legalBasis: NIRC Sec 34(L), as amended by RA 9504
osd.notes: For individuals, OSD is 40% of gross sales/receipts (corporations compute it on gross income instead). Election is irrevocable for the taxable year.

legalBasis: NIRC Sec 32(B)(7)(e), as amended by RA 10963
thirteenthMonthExclusionCap.notes: 13th month pay and other benefits excluded from gross income up to ₱90,000 per year.

legalBasis: NIRC Sec 56(A)(2), as amended by RA 10963
annualITRInstallment.notes: When annual income tax due exceeds ₱2,000, individuals may pay in two equal installments — at filing, and on or before October 15.

legalBasis: NIRC Sec 232, as amended by RA 11976 (EOPT)
RR 8-2018 (8% filers keep books but need no audited FS)
afsRequiredAboveGross.notes: Books audited by an independent CPA required when gross annual sales exceed ₱3,000,000 (EOPT raised the old ₱150,000/quarterly threshold). Individuals validly on the 8% option or claiming the OSD are not required to submit audited FS — confirm applicability with your CPA.
